criteria.text: Replace outlined Card session items with compact borderless rows on screen background, 56px minimum touch-friendly height, one-line title and compact metadata, no persistent border/shadow/card fill.
Preserve whole-row navigation and existing 48x48 overflow actions, online/busy disabling, rename/archive/restore/fork/delete behavior.
Every record with children has an independent 48x48 disclosure button; all expanded by default. Tapping disclosure never opens the chat.

Local ChatList Set<string> collapse state only; collapsing any parent hides its entire descendant subtree but not siblings; nested parents toggle independently; expanding restores existing sorted order.
Parent title medium weight; children regular/quieter with 12px depth indentation capped at 24px while preserving actual hierarchy level in accessibility labels.
Collapsed parent metadata includes total hidden descendant count and running descendant count when derivable from existing status; no new data fetch.

Search ignores collapse so matching hidden descendants remain discoverable, without mutating collapsed IDs; clearing search restores prior collapse. Preserve current row-level search semantics—do not inject nonmatching ancestors.
Disclosure labels name expand/collapse target and expose accessibilityState.expanded. Row labels include title, hierarchy level, status/project and hidden summary where relevant.

criteria.reason: Verification gate must confirm the diff is confined to the exclusive UI, contract, and run-note files.

criteria.text: VoiceOver can independently focus and activate sibling row-open, disclosure, and overflow controls; the row container does not group them, and disclosure does not navigate.
A 10-level fixture processes each node once without duplicate traversal work and correctly reports descendant and running totals.
Compact normal-size metadata uses an existing stronger semantic color role that meets normal-text contrast.
Child titles use an existing stronger semantic text role that meets at least 4.5:1 contrast on the #F4F7F4 background in both themes, while retaining a quieter hierarchy through typography.
The sibling row-open Pressable is at least 44pt high by filling the available 56pt row height, without reducing the independent 48pt disclosure and overflow targets or nesting accessible controls.
